description: This file contains functions for managing user rights and roles within the TestLink project, including initialization of rights mappings, permission checking, role retrieval at project and plan levels, role management, and localization support.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: A class representing user roles, with methods for database operations related to roles.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class for handling test plan data retrieval from the database.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing user entities within TestLink, including methods for retrieving user data and roles.

methods.name: init_global_rights_maps
methods.description: Initializes global rights and permissions mappings, including localization of rights descriptions.

methods.name: has_rights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the specified right, optionally at a specific project or plan level.

methods.name: propagateRights
methods.description: Propagates inherited rights from one role set to another.

methods.name: checkForRights
methods.description: Determines if a set of rights includes specific rights, supporting AND/OR logic.

methods.name: get_tproject_effective_role
methods.description: Retrieves the effective role of users at a test project level, including inherited roles.

methods.name: get_tplan_effective_role
methods.description: Retrieves the effective role of users at a test plan level, considering inheritance from test project roles.

methods.name: getRoleErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns an error message based on role operation result codes.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a specified role from the database, with audit logging.
